name: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning Benchmark
description: URLB is a benchmark for unsupervised reinforcement learning that consists of two phases: reward-free pre-training and downstream task adaptation with extrinsic rewards. It includes twelve continuous control tasks from three domains based on the DeepMind Control Suite and provides open-source code for eight leading unsupervised RL methods.
reputation: URLB is a widely cited benchmark for unsupervised RL, commonly used to compare reward-free pretraining and downstream adaptation methods on standard continuous-control tasks.
notes: Benchmark includes reward-free pre-training and downstream adaptation phases; based on DeepMind Control Suite tasks.
